summary: Implements migration architecture supporting dual-write between PostgreSQL and MongoDB, CDC backfill, parity validation, and rollback readiness with backward-compatible APIs in Node.js/Express.

code_files.description: Defines Express routes for customer API endpoints maintaining backward compatibility.
Handles customer CRUD operations and migration status monitoring.
Implements dual-write logic with feature flag control and data validation.
PostgreSQL repository for customer data access.
MongoDB repository implementation with schema validation and indexing.
Service exposing migration status metrics including CDC lag and parity results.
Simple feature flag configuration enabling dual-write and Mongo reads.

environment_variables.name: DUAL_WRITE_ENABLED
environment_variables.description: Feature flag to enable dual-write mode

environment_variables.name: READ_FROM_MONGO
environment_variables.description: Feature flag toggling MongoDB for read operations during migration

environment_variables.name: CDC_LAG
environment_variables.description: Current CDC lag in seconds reported by monitor

environment_variables.name: DATA_PARITY
environment_variables.description: Parity percentage between PostgreSQL and MongoDB data sets
